How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return, please follow these steps:
Create your return online
Visit our returns portal and enter your order number along with your postcode or the email address used to place the order. Click "Get Started," select the item(s) you wish to return, provide the reason for the return, and follow the instructions provided. Once your return is logged, you will receive an email with further instructions and a free returns barcode label.
Pack your return
Place the items you wish to return in secure packaging. We encourage reusing the polybag your items arrived in. Ensure the package is securely sealed.
Ship your return
For UK customers: Take the QR code to a nearby drop-off location to scan and return the parcel.
For international customers: Print the PDF label provided, attach it firmly to the parcel (ensuring it covers any pre-existing labels), and take it to your local drop-off location.
Return confirmation and refund
Once your parcel is received and inspected by our quality assurance team, you will be notified of the progress. Refunds are processed within 14 days from when the return is received.
Please note that we do not currently offer exchanges. If you need a different size or item, you can return the unsuitable item for a refund and place a new order.
